anomalies.description: Multiple players from both teams engage in a physical altercation near the sideline, involving grabbing, pushing, and shoving; referees and staff intervene to separate them.

Multiple players from both teams (Raptors in red, Cavaliers in black/yellow) engage in a physical altercation near the sideline, involving pushing, grabbing, and shoving; referees and staff intervene to separate them.

The on-court fighting escalates into a broader chaotic scene with multiple players, coaches, and spectators involved; crowd members lean over barriers, security personnel rush in, and the situation becomes a large-scale violent group clash beyond a simple two-person fight.

A multi-person physical altercation erupts on the court near the sideline, involving players, coaches, and security personnel; individuals are seen grappling, pushing, and restraining each other in a chaotic cluster.
During the ongoing fight, one individual appears to be on the ground or in a vulnerable position while others surround and engage with him, suggesting potential targeting of a helpless person.

A physical altercation occurs: a player in red (No. 9) is pushed or struck by a player in green/gold, causing him to fall backward onto the court. The green/gold player then stands over him with an aggressive posture while another teammate approaches.
A player in red (No. 9) is on the floor after contact; another player in black/gold stands over him and appears to strike or push him while he is down, constituting an attack on a helpless victim.
Two players engage in mutual physical combat: a player in red (No. 9) and a player in black/gold (No. 0) grapple, push, and exchange punches near the sideline padding.
